title: Candidacy Examination
description: Students enrol in NURS 693 to prepare for their candidacy examination. that includes: 1) completing candidacy exam papers or open-book exam and 2) successfully developing and defending a research proposal. Both milestones require an oral examination. The content of the papers or exam is related to course work, the substance and methodology of students' research interests, and provides a basis for proposal development. Must be completed prior to registration in NURS 699.
